title: Etale modules on a field and discrete Galois modules
statement:
Let $K$ be a field, fix $K^{\rm sep}$, put
$G=\operatorname{Gal}(K^{\rm sep}/K)$, and let $A$ be
a finite commutative ring. The geometric fibre functor
identifies etale
$A$-module sheaves on $\operatorname{Spec}K$ with
discrete continuous
$A[G]$-modules, as exact abelian categories with their
section functors. Sections correspond to invariants.

proof.text: Apply the abelian-sheaf equivalence at Omega=AlgebraicClosure(Ks), obtaining Eab and its additive stalk comparison and Galois germ formula. Enhance Eab to R-module sheaves using the proved scalar transport equivalence.

proof.text: Extension from Ks to Omega induces the proved natural stalk isomorphism; compose its inverse with the module stalk comparison. For each g extend it to an automorphism of Omega. Compatibility of this automorphism with Ks gives equality of the changed extended lifts. The formula on germs and inverse-isomorphism cancellation give exactly the required action equation at Ks.

lean.statement: theorem etaleModuleSheaves_equiv_discreteGModules (K Ks : Type u) [Field K] [Field Ks] [Algebra K Ks] [IsSepClosure K Ks] (A : Type v) [CommRing A] [Finite A] : let S := Spec (.of K) let J := S.smallEtaleTopology let s := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K Ks)) let p := pointSmallEtale s let G := Gal(Ks/K) let D := Rep.DiscreteContinuousRep.{v, u, max (u + 1) v} A G let U : D ⥤ Rep.{max (u + 1) v} A G := ObjectProperty.ι _ ∃ (E : Sheaf J (ModuleCat.{max (u + 1) v} A) ≌ D) (i : E.functor ⋙ U ⋙ Rep.RepToAction A G ⋙ Action.forget (ModuleCat.{max (u + 1) v} A) G ≅ p.sheafFiber) (_σ : (sheafSections J (ModuleCat.{max (u + 1) v} A)).obj (op (Etale.mk (𝟙 S))) ≅ E.functor ⋙ U ⋙ Rep.invariantsFunctor A G), ∀ (F : Sheaf J (ModuleCat.{max (u + 1) v} A)) (g : G) (X : S.Etale) (x x' : p.fiber.obj X) (_hx : x'.left = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom g.toRingHom) ≫ x.left) (z : F.obj.obj (op X)), (i.hom.app F) ((E.functor.obj F).obj.ρ g ((i.inv.app F) (p.toPresheafFiber X x F.obj z))) = p.toPresheafFiber X x' F.obj z
